params.name: elementRef
params.description: Root XML element reference to export

params.name: vXmlVar
params.description: Text or BLOB variable that receives the exported XML tree

overloads.semanticRole: Saves an XML tree into a Text or BLOB variable in memory.

constraints: vXmlVar must be a Text or BLOB variable; a Text variable is limited to 32K in non-Unicode mode (2GB in Unicode mode), and in non-Unicode mode its content loses its original encoding declaration (use BLOB to preserve valid, sendable XML in that case).
On export, internal LF line breaks are replaced by CRLF on Windows (no replacement on macOS); use an XML CDATA element (or the "" entity) to preserve literal carriage returns.
Written without a BOM by default; line-ending and BOM behavior are controlled via XML SET OPTIONS.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
